title: Wavelet-CFM for the extragalactic millimeter-wave sky
abstract: arXiv:2611.28695v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We develop a Wavelet-factorized Conditional Flow Matching (Wavelet-CFM) framework to generate fast, accurate simulations of correlated astrophysical fields including gravitational lensing convergence ($\kappa$), the kinetic and thermal Sunyaev-Zel'dovich (kSZ and tSZ) effects, and cosmic infrared background (CIB) emission. Together these make up every bright extragalactic component of the millimeter-wave (mm-wave) sky apart from radio sources. Our approach combines multi-scale wavelet decomposition with conditional flow matching models, trained on $\sim$9$\times$9 deg$^2$ patches at 1-arcminute resolution. The four fields are generated jointly, including their cross couplings, and the model has a tractable likelihood, which to our knowledge has not previously been achieved for this set of components. The power spectra, one-point distributions and Minkowski functionals of the generated maps match a validation set to a few percent. These

translated_title: 面向河外毫米波天空的Wavelet-CFM（小波因子化条件流匹配）方法
translated_abstract: 我们开发了一种小波因子化条件流匹配框架，用于对相互关联的天体物理场进行快速、精确的模拟，包括引力透镜收敛场（κ）、动力学与热苏尼亚耶夫-泽尔多维奇效应以及宇宙红外背景（CIB）辐射。这些成分共同构成了毫米波天空观测中除射电源之外的所有明亮河外成分。我们的方法将多尺度小波分解与条件流匹配模型相结合，在分辨率为1角分的约9×9平方度的区块上进行训练。四个场可以联合生成，并包含它们之间的交叉耦合，且该模型具有可计算的似然函数——据我们所知，此前尚未有人针对这一组成分实现过这一目标。所生成地图的功率谱、单点分布和Minkowski泛函与验证集相比，匹配误差仅为百分之几。
tldr: 提出了结合多尺度小波分解与条件流匹配的Wavelet-CFM生成框架，能够联合且精确地模拟包括引力透镜收敛、kSZ、tSZ和CIB在内的相互关联的毫米波天空河外成分，并首次为这组成分实现了可计算的似然函数。
en_tdlr: We propose Wavelet-CFM, a generative framework combining multi-scale wavelet decomposition with conditional flow matching that jointly and accurately simulates correlated extragalactic millimeter-wave components (lensing convergence, kSZ, tSZ, and CIB), achieving tractable likelihoods for this set of components for the first time.
